newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE shares mostly steady, index declines.
newsitem.headline: UAE shares mostly steady, index declines.

text.p: Shares on the unofficial United Arab Emirates stock market were largely steady in the week to Thursday in quiet trade as investors waited for the remaining 1996 end-year results of companies and banks, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index declined to 2,483.62 points from 2,533.39.
Brokers attributed the decline to a fall in the shares of market leader Etisalat, the UAE telecommunications company, to 952 dirhams from 1,175 dirhams.
Etisalat shares had picked up in the first week of February following a week-long break during which a 25 dirham cash dividend was paid to shareholders for the second half of 1996.
Al-Ain al-Ahlia insurance company continued its rise to 1,300 dirhams from 1,270. NBAD rose five dirhams to 460.
United National Bank was steady at 355. Dubai Commercial Bank also remained unchanged at 58. -- Dubai newsroom +9714-626990
